description:
Another day of hard work for Hansi Flick's team at St. George's Park. This morning and afternoon the blaugranes continued preparations for the upcoming friendly match against Birmingham City with another session at the English FA facilities.

The main news today was the involvement of Raphinha and Alejandro Balde, who both completed part of the training with the group.
